**Finding submitted: deviation (WARRANTY).**

- **Investigation:** Section 9 "Warranties" (p0055–p0058) contains only mutual corporate-existence/authority representations plus a Globix acknowledgment. HDI's Responsibilities (Sections 1.1–1.8) impose delivery and hosting duties but no performance standard; Section 1.6 gives only a termination right if the Site is late. Searches for "AS IS", disclaimers, implied warranties, workmanlike, documentation and malicious code returned nothing — so no disclaimer swallows anything, but there is also no express performance warranty or remedy.
- **Classification:** Fails every fallback element → deviation (not walk-away, since nothing is disclaimed).
- **Cure (fallback target, single insert after p0058):** new Section 9(c) warranting 90-day conformance of the Site/software to its documentation, 30-day professional and workmanlike performance of the Services, with repair/replacement or refund as our remedy. No survival tail, malicious-code, or compliance-with-laws extras were added, since those sit at the preferred level only.
